items.source: Note that ConnectionLostException will be passed into this method when the connection is lost rather than closed normally via StompSession.disconnect().
items.translation: 注意，当连接丢失而不是通过 StompSession.disconnect() 正常关闭时，ConnectionLostException 将传入此方法。

items.source: This contract also extends StompFrameHandler in order to handle STOMP ERROR frames received from the broker.
items.translation: 该合同还扩展了StompFrameHandler，以便处理从代理接收的 STOMP ERROR 帧。

items.source: Implementations of this interface should consider extending StompSessionHandlerAdapter.
items.translation: 实现此接口的实现类应考虑扩展 StompSessionHandlerAdapter。

items.source: Handle any exception arising while processing a STOMP frame such as a failure to convert the payload or an unhandled exception in the application StompFrameHandler.
items.translation: 处理处理 STOMP 帧时出现的任何异常，例如无法转换负载或在应用程序StompFrameHandler中未处理的异常。

items.source:
Invoked when the session is ready to use, i.e. after the underlying
transport (TCP, WebSocket) is connected and a STOMP CONNECTED frame is
received from the broker.
items.translation: 在会话准备好使用时被调用，即在底层传输（TCP、WebSocket）连接建立并从代理接收到 STOMP CONNECTED 帧之后。

Handle a low level transport error which could be an I/O error or a
failure to encode or decode a STOMP message.
items.translation: 处理低级传输错误，该错误可能是 I/O 错误或无法对 STOMP 消息进行编码或解码。
